messages:
jen: heads-up — after the config migration this morning i noticed the console preview shows different effective override counts vs prod sampling :eyes:
jen: i ran a quick check for cohort=beta-users and the preview UI says ~2.1k affected but the live telemetry shows ~1.3k
sam: can you paste the preview params you used? i want to repro locally
jen: preview api: GET /api/v1/configs/preview?change_id=c-987&sample_seed=2026&cohort=beta-users
jen: response had "effective_overrides": 2104
jen: but prod event count for change c-987 tagged with rollout=safe-preview is 1327
mike: weird — could be hash-salt drift between preview and prod evaluators (we changed the bucket hash in runtime v2)
priya: the console preview uses the client-side evaluator in the browser (to avoid expensive server calls). did migration flip the default salt?
jen: good call. i looked at runtime flags: runtime.bucket_salt was toggled in the migration and preview library still uses the old embedded salt
alex: that would explain mismatch. two things: (1) preview needs to call a deterministic server-side explain endpoint for authoritative counts; (2) we should add a telemetry field on config-change that records the salt used for evaluation
sam: +1. also we should avoid the console re-embedding salts in builds. shipping a dynamic salt lookup to the console makes preview consistent
priya: UX note — we need to keep preview snappy. hitting a server-side explain for every refresh could be slow. propose: (a) lightweight sampled explain (10k ids) with streaming; (b) cached last-explain for 5m
mike: API sketch: POST /api/v1/configs/explain with body {"change_id":"c-987","sample_size":10000,"seed":2026} returns a streaming newline-delimited JSON where each line is: {"id": "user_123","decision": "override_applied","trace": ["rule-3","whitelist-check"]}
jen: that trace field is critical — ops asked for decision lineage so they can audit why an override fired
alex: add metadata: {"bucket_salt":"s-2026-05","evaluator_version":"v2.1"} in the explain envelope. we'll log that in telemetry too
priya: console will display a small "sample preview" card with counts and a link to "view trace" that streams a handful of rows on demand. 10k sample for counts only, view trace limited to 50 rows
sam: implementation note: evaluator v2 has a slightly different hash algorithm. we must guarantee zero-drift by shipping a deterministic shim that uses the server salt and algorithm for browser preview if server-side explain absent
mike: alternative: embed a hashing endpoint GET /api/v1/hash?ids=...&salt=s-2026-05 to precompute buckets. cheaper than full explain and keeps UI responsive\enjen: (typo) jen: +1 to the hashing endpoint idea — console can call hash endpoint to show counts in <500ms and call explain when user wants traces
jen: we should also add change-level telemetry fields: applied_salt, evaluator_version, sample_seed so we can reconcile preview vs prod with a single query
alex: ops playbook: if counts diverge > 10% between preview and live during rollout, auto-pause rollout and notify #oncall with a summary including last_explain_id
priya: question for PM/Legal — exposing sample ids in the console might have privacy implications. better to show anonymized ids or suffix-hash only
sam: agree. we should return truncated ids like user_<sha256(id)[:8]> in UI traces and keep full ids only in secured logs for SREs
mike: small breaking API change proposal — explain endpoint adds a stable explain_id in response headers (Explain-ID) so we can reference the exact sample used in telemetry and SLOs
jen: example payload sketch for explain (we can include in PR):
```json
{
  "explain_id": "ex-20260321-c987-0001",
  "metadata": {
    "bucket_salt": "s-2026-05",
    "evaluator_version": "v2.1",
    "sample_seed": "2026"
  },
  "summary": {
    "sample_size": 10000,
    "overrides": 2104,
    "percentage": 21.04
  },
  "streaming": true
}
```
sam: looks good. implementation tasks: 1) hashing endpoint, 2) explain endpoint streaming, 3) telemetry fields on config-change events, 4) console UI card + privacy truncation
priya: i'll file a small design ticket for UI and privacy constraints, will mock the 50-row trace view
jen: i'll own a short ops doc describing how to reconcile previews using explain_id and the query to compare telemetry counts
alex: i'll update the rollout playbook to include the auto-pause threshold and add a runbook step to fetch explain_id and sample traces
mike: i can pick up the server endpoints this sprint. plan: hashing endpoint and explain streaming in first PR, telemetry in follow-up
jen: let's aim for a light canary: enable explain in staging and run a cross-check job that compares explain vs existing prod telemetry for 24h before flipping to prod
sam: note — watch memory for streaming explain with 10k items. implement as ndjson streaming with backpressure and chunked responses
priya: ux: add a subtle warning banner when preview uses cached salt vs authoritative explain: "Preview uses cached evaluator; run authoritative explain to confirm counts"
jen: :thumbsup: thanks all. i'll open the design + ops tickets and assign to folks.
deploy-bot: preflight for change c-987 (configs-service) completed — smoke tests passed :white_check_mark:
alex: when PRs land, i'll trigger the staging cross-check job and post results to this thread
jen: sounds good — marking this convo as action items for the sprint planning
